control.EH: Original enter_handler/catch_bind/finally_enter and real completion route graph; EH-control differs from escaping mayThrow. Pure invoke projection scaffolding alone is not Source EH.
control.construction: receiver_bind/get/result have no direct result and exactly normal/language successors. Initialization rights are per successful bind, path and activation; language abrupt completion may abandon rights while preserving the binding, partial fields and prior effects. Request termination is not a language successor.
control.initialization: Complete Source-order module initializer bodies are independently verified and kept separate from kernel reachability.
control.invoke: Exactly normal and language-exception successors, independently checked actual signature and argument order.
control.invoke_method: Original static method and signature plus the complete independently reconstructed dispatch table. Receiver and all arguments evaluate once. Two normal/language successors; actual calls filter receiver tag and object identity per arm.
control.numeric_use: Exactly one normal native-i32 successor. Both original operands evaluate first, then numeric operand checks in Source order. Failure terminates request.
control.ordinary: Real standard cf.br/cf.cond_br and func.return; original source anchors retained.

environment.activation: One env_alloc entry prefix per factory activation; parent operand iff layout has parent. Actual activation plus callsite distinguishes instances; repeated recursive/loop sites remain weak summaries.
environment.carrier: env:<stable layout ID>; eight-byte managed reference; not a Source semantic type
environment.closure: make_closure has zero operands for null environment_layout, otherwise one exact lexical environment. Code and environment identity remain one saved pair; no type-wide environment permission.
environment.entry: Nested function lexicalEnvironment is a hidden first env argument. It never changes Source signature or Published parameter indices.
environment.slots: env_init/load/store properties layout, original raw binding, stable key; init/store env+value -> no result; load env -> slot carrier. env_parent child -> exact direct parent.

hosts.binding: Source ambient Host ID and structural signature remain separate from capability31 ABI signature. Complete VM/AOT BuildIdentity/BuildInputSet and reviewed implementation-bound HSC are independently verified by each cold consumer.
hosts.execution: Static validation only; no Host/native/VM/AOT execution authority.
hosts.operation: host_call evaluates ordered native scalar arguments once; verified Counter has a normal unknown-i32 result, both fixed resources are read-write even for argument0; no callback, borrow or retention grant.

identity.currentArtifact: Original raw fact IDs/ranges/runtimeKey, source bytes, input identity and HIR/representation hashes bind only the complete current artifact.
identity.functions: Existing tsfg.module-callable-function.candidate.v1 over source path, canonical qualified declaration path/kind/name, and stable signature.
identity.globals: Existing tsfg.global over module source path, declaration name or unique $default slot, and stable semantic type ID.
identity.published: Stable semantic declaration keys, labelled complete type-shape graph, signatures, module/import/export/root scope and fixed upper only. Never current body, Derived, source digest or raw range IDs.

indirectCall.order: Saved callee pair first, then all original arguments in order, once; exactly normal/language successors.
indirectCall.properties: signature_hash is the structural Source signature; targets={top,functions:[{function_id,signature_hash}]} is exact fixed-flow upper, not signature enumeration
indirectCall.publication: Complete fixed parameter/return/slot transfers are independently checked. Consume every allowed target fixed upper; body or site observations cannot narrow it.

initializers.range: [0, original module Source UTF16 length); no fabricated Source function/type

kernel: Validate the complete Program for every request. targets=[] requests no kernel permission and has empty accesses/pairs. Nonempty requests have 2..32 declared kernel roots and complete fixed upper checks; all fixed Host resource access is rejected at its actual call origin.

fields: hir_hash:StringAttr SHA256 canonical HIR plus LF
representation_hash:StringAttr SHA256 canonical representation plus LF
publication:StringAttr canonical fixed Published JSON without LF
request:StringAttr canonical kernel request JSON without LF
proof:StringAttr canonical supplied proof JSON without LF
marker.name: tsfg_program.program

methodDispatch.abi: Join complete target ABI capacities without changing actual tags. Each arm passes only its receiver-filtered actual value and evaluated parameter prefix; unsupported missing parameters remain rejected.
methodDispatch.order: Strict receiver_type byte order; one exact effective target per eligible owned nominal actual type.
methodDispatch.publication: Consume every selected target fixed upper in body/effects, call graph, SCC and multiplicity. Never substitute the static member upper or a narrower current body.
methodDispatch.selection: Override chain first, else independently validated M12 source-member mapping followed by actual override selection. The table grants no actual tags. Constructors and explicit base calls remain single-target invoke.

operationAttributes: view_type:StringAttr semantic type ID or void

ownedHir.complete: One official Program and original raw Symbol/type/source directory. All functions, module initializers and ordinary code remain represented; no partial-package composition.

physicalTypes.carrier: !tsfg_program.carrier<carrierKey>; independent exact type/domain layout, never a universal width.
physicalTypes.cell: !tsfg_program.cell<originalBindingId>; internal compiler storage, not a Source nominal.
physicalTypes.initialization: !tsfg_program.carrier<"initialization:" + ownerTypeId>; internal path-linear initialization cursor, never ordinary storage or a Source value.
physicalTypes.native: Existing exact native scalar MLIR types.
physicalTypes.receiver: !tsfg_program.carrier<"receiver:" + ownerTypeId>; internal constructor control frame, never an actual Source value or parameter-0 object.

publication.access: Exact GlobalId reads/writes and parameter-owner read/write/structural bounds; never derive a narrower permission from current implementation.
publication.captures: upper.captures=[{slot,read,write,structural}]; stable parent/layout/membership is scoped; current instances/ranges are not

hostResources.writes: Sorted fixed resources; complete callees/SCC/indirect upper consumption, never narrowed by body

publication.record: Complete functionId/signatureHash/fixed upper/digest; body plus every actual callee fixed upper must satisfy it before selecting kernels.
publication.scope: Stable complete semantic declarations/type shapes/modules/globals/imports/exports/roots; excludes current bodies and initialization-body/source identities.

receiverProtocol.allocation: receiver_create/child create only control identities. Only a base receiver_allocate allocates the dynamic newTarget instance. Bind occurs after complete base Construct; duplicate binding language-fails without replacing the previous bound value.
receiverProtocol.entry: An explicit constructor has one hidden receiver:owner physical parameter after any lexical environment. It does not seed a this object or Cell. receiver_get/bind/result supply selected payload facts.
receiverProtocol.initialization: initialize_begin consumes the successful binding right; initialize_field consumes the exact current cursor and next own initialization FieldId in Source order; initialize_end consumes the complete cursor. Normal completion cannot skip unfinished rights. Language abrupt completion preserves earlier writes and escape.
receiverProtocol.owner: Complete semantic TypeId joined to the existing construction owner; new_target is the dynamic original newTarget and never retags a replacement object.
receiverProtocol.results: receiver_result selects the already evaluated explicit object return or applies base/derived undefined/primitive rules after body/finally completion. No frame, owner view or TypeId changes actual object identity/tag/layout.
receiverProtocol.status: draft exact private4 protocol, not formal wire adoption
receiverProtocol.wire: The draft control sizes and receiver:owner/initialization:owner names do not authorize existing wire17. New carrier/ABI/index/cold-reader/Runtime mapping and authoritative Core/wire versions remain separate unadopted dependencies.

representation.actual: Reached actual tags/values remain distinct from conditional storage/ABI capacity. Assertion, alias, storage, call and return preserve actual tags. Only approved same-i32/undefined numeric consumption has a request-trap edge; no language handler or finally edge.
representation.bindings: Complete original BindingId -> physical carrier capacity, including module/catch/local/receiver cells; original Source fieldId selects the shared conditional field capacity; element:<owned Array SemanticTypeId> selects the shared conditional Array element capacity. Actual object/array instances and normal values remain separate.
representation.domains: Existing tsfg.actual-domain.v1 identity over sorted actual semantic TypeIDs; exact layout/tag/root-count independently recomputed.
representation.functions: Stable owned FunctionId -> ordered parameter carrier capacities and result carrier. Explicit constructors replace the ordinary receiver physical parameter with receiver:owner after any lexical environment; logical Published owner indices do not change. Methods retain ordinary receiver values.

sourceScope: Source facts v2 retains one complete official Program and named function/capture/indirect facts; no arrow, bound-method value, block/loop capture or Host permission.
status: Private Core4 receiver protocol development profile; constructor-body borrow proof remains OPEN; no wire17 or Runtime execution qualification

internalConstructors.directory: Required representation.internalConstructors, strictly sorted by internal id; exact public-projected-invoke reachable helper closure; [] when empty.
internalConstructors.id: analysis-construction: + original ConstructionId; never a Published FunctionId or a public function-table member.
internalConstructors.parameters: receiver:owner hidden control first, then original construction parameter capacities by ordinal; no lexical environment.
internalConstructors.bindings: Exact private parameter storage rows {id,carrier}, strictly sorted by id; id + /parameter/ + decimal ordinal; no receiver Cell.
internalConstructors.result: Same solved selected result carrier, preserving actual U and normal Bottom.
internalConstructors.source: Independently pre-register all implicit owners/parameters, reconstruct SourcePlan and compare every supplied helper body/anchor/ABI. No public HIR/Scope mutation.
internalConstructors.effects: Current-body internal constructor summaries compose in the existing finite Source effect domain; ordinary public calls consume the complete fixed upper, never their current body.
internalConstructors.fuel: No added implicit-constructor entry fuel; ordinary public and Source call/loop fuel retain semantics.
internalConstructors.status: Private Core4 draft only; no formal Runtime/wire/native admission.
